name: marian-coach
description: Plugins for engineering leaders by Marian Kamenistak: marian-coach for your own career, engineering-leadership for your team and org.

plugins.name: marian-coach
plugins.description: Your own career as an engineering leader: are you ready to lead, what are you worth in salary and market value, how do you look from outside, your one-minute pitch, your promotion case, your first 90 days in a new role, your next 1:1 with your manager, and how do you get your company to pay for mentoring. Built from 3,662 mentoring sessions with engineering leaders since 2019.

plugins.name: engineering-leadership
plugins.description: For your team and your org: delivery KPIs from your Jira data and a 6-sprint plan to fix them, your manager-to-senior-IC ratio against a peer baseline, and a go or no-go check before you launch a local leadership community. From the Engineering Leaders Community.
